## 2026-11-01 S1794: fibre functor for finite etale K-algebras, six fields (partial)

- Target: PreGaloisCategory.FiberFunctor (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.fiber K Omega), the
  six-field residual of S1739/S1767.
- RESULT (kernel checked, no sorryAx): Field 1 (preservesTerminalObjects) is PROVED
  unconditionally for any field K and any field Omega with Algebra K Omega:
  S1794.preservesTerminalObjects_pempty : PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1})
  (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.fiber K Omega).  Route: op K terminal in (FiniteEtale K)^op;
  fibre at K is the singleton Hom_K(K,Omega); IsTerminal -> IsIso(terminalComparison)
  -> PreservesLimit(Functor.empty) -> pempty instance.
- RESULT (kernel checked): product decomposition in consumer form
  S1794.exists_prod_fields (from Mathlib Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod, Finite
  upgraded to Fintype: A =~[K] Prod i, Ai i, Ai finite separable fields).
- RESULT (kernel checked): algebraic half of Field 3, S1794.homProdField_holds:
  Hom_K(Prod j, A j, Omega) = Sigma j, Hom_K(A j, Omega) for a finite family of K-algebras
  and a field Omega (orthogonal idempotent Pi.single j 1 argument; proved via
  Equiv.ofBijective + Equiv.ofBijective ... .symm, avoiding dependent Sigma transport).
- MISSING (exact, in class-field order; each a named Prop + sorry theorem in the file):
  1. PreservesPullbacksField = PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan (fiber K Omega)
     (needs Hom_K(B (x)_A C, Omega) ~ Hom_K(B,Omega) x_{Hom_K(A,Omega)} Hom_K(C,Omega) with
     the S1745 tensor-product pushout in the full subcategory). THIS IS THE FIRST MISSING.
  2. PreservesFiniteCoproductsField: only the categorical half is now missing (the
     FintypeCat colimit comparison for the coproduct cocone); the algebraic half is the
     item above.
  3. PreservesEpisField: needs mono(in FiniteEtale K) => injective + exactness/faithful
     flatness of Omega (x)_K - (Omega separably closed).  Mathlib has no
     mono_iff_injective for CommAlgCat and no lTensor-injectivity API in
     LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct (checked by grep in this workspace).
  4. PreservesQuotientsByFiniteGroupsField: needs Omega (x)_K A^G = (Omega (x)_K A)^G
     plus the orbit computation Hom_K(A,Omega)/G; S1770 supplies A^G finite etale and the
     limit cone (invariantsIsLimit) but not this.
  5. ReflectsIsosField: descent along the faithfully flat K -> Omega.
- File: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1794FiberFunctorProductActual.lean (531 lines, 25369+ bytes,
  SHA256 3930DCBA4239C8F58C4D311B286753DCADDB33327A6FF5EFF6FD685C9BC1A53B).  Imports only
  Mathlib (Etale.Finite, Galois.Basic, Limits.Preserves.Shapes.Terminal, Limits.FintypeCat,
  Etale.Field); does NOT depend on S1770.
- Build: lake env lean -j1 -R 'D:\lean' -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/
  S1794FiberFunctorProductActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1794FiberFunctorProductActual.lean;
  EXIT=0 (5 declared sorry warnings only).  Downstream import check
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1794ImportCheck.lean: EXIT=0.
- Olean: .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1794FiberFunctorProductActual.olean
  (522064 bytes, 2026-11-01 02:21).
- Axioms: #print axioms on the Section 1/2/3-proved declarations
  (subsingleton_hom_self, isTerminal_self, subsingleton_fiber_self, nonempty_fiber_self,
  isTerminal_fiber_self, isTerminal_fiber_top, preservesTerminalObjects,
  preservesTerminalObjects_pempty, exists_prod_fields, exists_prod_fields_obj,
  homProdField_holds) reports exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].  The five
  residual theorems and fiberFunctorOfFields report [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice,
  Quot.sound], reported not hidden.
- Useful reusable finding (for the next agent): the Yoneda reduction of the remaining
  categorical fields is viable in principle.  F := fiber K Omega satisfies
  F & FintypeCat.incl = (finiteEtale K).iota.op & Phi definitionally at object and morphism
  level (both rfl, confirmed in probes), where Phi S = (S.unop ->_alg[K] Omega), and
  yoneda_preservesLimits is an instance.  Blocking step: the naturality squares of the two
  NatIsos need ConcreteCategory.comp_apply plumbing for the Type-category homs (Type's homs
  are bundled, so rfl/funext do not close them).  If completed, the fields
  preservesPullbacks / preservesFiniteCoproducts / preservesQuotientsByFiniteGroups follow
  uniformly from: P.IsClosedUnder{Co,}limitsOfShape (J^op) (S1745/S1770 + of_equivalence),
  creates{Co,}limitsOfShapeFullSubcategoryInclusion,
  preserves{Co,}limitsOfShape_op, and
  preserves{Co,}limitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves with FintypeCat.incl
  (= forget FintypeCat, which creates finite limits/colimits).
- Environment note: concurrent lake/lean builds by other sessions caused intermittent
  "failed to read file ...olean" errors on this shared workspace; both final builds above
  succeeded on retry (EXIT=0).

'@
Add-Content -Path D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Value $entry
Write-Output "appended"
Get-Content D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 5
